description: OS Open Roads is a dataset listed in UK national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Ordnance Survey. OS Open Roads is a high-level view of the road network, from motorways to country lanes in Great Britain. The links represent an approximate central alignment of the road carriageway and include roads classified by the National or Local Highway authority (for example, A Roads) and unclassified roads which make up Great Britain’s road network. Coverage: United Kingdom. The portal files it under the publisher Ordnance Survey. Its tags are Road network, Roads, Transport networks, motorway, road network. The portal shows 2025-04-16 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-uk-portal.
